units: configurable academic-utility points, not money or measured student outcomes
profit_overrides: An option may specify profit; otherwise base_course_profit applies.
overload_formula: Year 4 only: 0.25 * max(0, selected semester credits - 12)^2; Years 1-3 zero overload penalty
hard_constraints: Existing course-count, credit, prerequisite, required-course, exclusion and timetable evidence constraints remain enforced.
